description: Record the human's answer to a customer-grouping question Aurgus asked — a grouping compute_close PROPOSED ('GPG LLC resembles Global Procurement Group LLC', or 'these are the GPO's members'), OR a change to a roster Aurgus already knows ('did anything change?' → a new member joined, or one left). Aurgus never changes a group on its own — this tool is the person's approval, and what makes Aurgus remember. Added names become DATE-CONTROLLED members of the agreement's customer scope so the NEXT close matches them automatically; removing a member ENDS its membership as-of a date (never deletes — its past purchases stay attributed, only later ones stop rolling up). Use ONLY after Aurgus surfaced the question and the user answered; pass the agreement_id and the name(s) exactly as they appear in the data. Set valid_from/valid_to for a real join/leave date (a GPO join, an acquisition, a rename, a member leaving); omit valid_from for open-ended. After confirming, run compute_close again to fold the change in.

agreement_id.description: The agreement whose customer scope this concerns — from the compute_close proposal or roster.

ended_members.description: Member(s) that LEFT the group — their membership is ended as-of valid_to (not deleted; prior purchases stay attributed).

name.description: The member that left, exactly as on file.

valid_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD — the date the membership ended (the last day they count as a member).

members.description: Name(s) the user confirmed BELONG to this agreement (added as members), exactly as they appear in the data.

name.description: The customer name to group, verbatim from the data (e.g. 'GPG LLC').

valid_from.description: YYYY-MM-DD — when the membership began (GPO join / rename date). Omit for open-ended.

valid_to.description: YYYY-MM-DD — when the membership ended, if already known. Omit for still-a-member.

name: confirm_grouping
